codeReview.summary: Most learn-git hardening is in place: tracked-only indexing, structured partial-failure reporting, and git subprocess timeouts. One blocking edge case remains where a re-learn with only deleted/missing tracked files throws before replaceSourceData runs, so stale documents can survive.

issues.description: If every tracked file is missing or unreadable, this guard throws before replaceSourceData() executes. That leaves the previous source data in place, so a re-learn can fail to remove deleted files from the index even though the source has been cleared.
The timeout regression is still marked test.skip, so the normal bun test suite does not guard the new git timeout path against regressions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The learn-worker procedure assumes the timeout regression can be covered in bun test, but this feature had to fall back to a standalone runner because the timeout fixture was flaky under the test harness. The skill may need a note for timeout-sensitive subprocess tests.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false; tests/learn-git-hardening.test.ts:546 uses test.skip for the timeout case

summary: Reviewed learn-git-hardening against the contract and found one blocking re-learn edge case plus one non-blocking test coverage gap.
